analysis_role: Specific falsification of historical persistence for the already-supported present-niche orientation transition regime. Test the only calendarized U->D event without screening any additional variable.

fixed_hypothesis.rationale: The present-niche H1/H2 regime was fixed as U->D aligning with higher BIO15 and lower BIO1. H4 asks whether the sole calendarized U->D event shares those same historical endpoint-change signs.

estimand: For each of the 376 chronology x paleolocation scenarios, match BIO15 and BIO1 rows by region, young_ma and old_ma. A scenario matches H4 iff BIO15 delta > 0 and BIO1 delta < 0. No rescaling or weighting of the two variables is allowed.

decision.historical_regime_persistence_supported: Each of all four predeclared regions has H4 sign match in >=0.75 of its 94 chronology scenarios.
decision.historical_regime_persistence_not_suppor: The support criterion is not met.
decision.historical_regime_opposite_direction_dom: In each of all four regions, the exact opposite sign pair (BIO15 < 0 and BIO1 > 0) occurs in >=0.75 of chronology scenarios.

secondary_outputs: number of chronology pairs with H4 match in 4/4, >=3/4, >=2/4 regions
claim_boundary: Scenario fractions are deterministic sensitivity-grid fractions, not posterior probabilities.
This test evaluates persistence of a predeclared sign regime only; it does not identify the historical causal environment.
Failure to match H4 would support origin-maintenance or history-present decoupling, but would not prove environment was irrelevant.
No additional paleoclimate variable, region, chronology, weighting, or threshold may be added after result inspection.
